title: check_data_use input
description: May this application use this data this way, and what is needed? Answers before anything is saved: the decision state the use would have, the rule that governs it and where that rule is set, who would be asked, and the tier answer the data implies. A use whose rule is never cannot be saved by anyone (G-25). Writes nothing.

applicationId.description: The application. Give this or intakeRequestId.

intakeRequestId.description: The intake request, before the application is registered.

domainKey.description: The data, by its domain. Give this, or locationId with container.

locationId.description: Where the application reaches the data.

container.description: The container as seen. With locationId, it names the domain through the mappings.

reachesAi.description: True when the data would be sent to an AI model or agent.

isDeidentified.description: True when only masked or de-identified data would be used.
